name: algorithm-design
description: Design an algorithm for a specific problem: problem statement + inputs + outputs + constraints, invariants, candidate approaches with time + space complexity, edge cases, correctness argument (loop invariant / induction / preservation), failure modes, pseudocode, test cases. Considers in-place vs extra memory, parallelizability, numerical stability. Produces a design for review before coding. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
